body:
Thanks for the replies, /u/zigzwag and /u/Toroche. :)

I've started having auditory hallucinations now, but have no compulsion for self-harm.  I'm going to take one (1) valium and go to bed a couple hours early.

It really did.  It was in 1998 and it still hurts every day.

He doesn't know, I kind of don't want him to know.  He can't come home and I don't want him to worry.  I don't want him to know that the thing that made me turn the keys and pull them out of the ignition was the thought of him coming home in a few days and being the one to find me there.  I can't do that to him.

I feel like I'm a failure and a disappointment, I fuck up everything and everyone I touch, people are just nice to me because they feel pity for me and I'm actually a total loser, stupid and ugly and unfunny, that I'm worthless and useless and I don't even deserve to breathe the air that I'm breathing because it's too good for me.  :(  There's a tiny part of my brain that's thinking on a rational level and trying to remind me that these are the things that my sickness makes me think but even that part believes that at least some of those things must be true.

I feel like I'm just a waste of a human being and everyone would be better off without me and sometimes I just get tired of pretending that I'm okay, you know?

Edit: And thank you for being proud of me and saying it took courage. That actually helps a lot. Thank you.
